summary: Repeated question; prior reply ignored the Helen Osman issue
detailed_context: Nick asked Jarvis to check why Helen Osman's attestation appears twice in the list, noting she has only one fob. He then sent the identical message again, so the previous response evidently did not answer it. That response instead described a build agent resuming six review fixes on the member-emails branch, which has nothing to do with the attestation list. The 'please' and the repeat suggest mild-to-clear frustration at being asked twice. Lesson: when a user repeats a question verbatim, address that exact question directly before anything else, and don't substitute unrelated status updates.
